findings.title: Un-delta'd baseline requirement 'spec-driven v1 gates and cadence' pins '(version 2)' and enumerates both reviewed gates without consent — post-archive self-contradiction
findings.recommendation: orbit/specs/orbit-engine-gates/spec.md:188-194 ('spec-driven v1 gates and cadence') states normatively: 'The shipped spec-driven schema (version 2) SHALL declare: review-proposal (kind: reviewed, requires/inputs the four artifacts, cadence: [independent, in-context], confirm: no-new-findings, before: apply), ... and review-system (...)'. This change bumps the shipped schema to version 3 (design D2, task 1.2) and adds consent: user-invoked to BOTH gates — and the change's own delta'd 'Gate declaration in schema YAML' requirement says so ('spec-driven sets consent: user-invoked on review-proposal ... and review-system ...'). Post-archive, the same baseline capability would simultaneously mandate a version-2 schema whose gate declarations lack consent AND a consent-bearing spec-driven declaration — the identical scope-miss class as iter 1's CRITICAL. Add this requirement as a third block in the engine-gates MODIFIED delta: full baseline text with '(version 2)' -> '(version 3)' and 'consent: user-invoked' added to the review-proposal and review-system enumerations (containment-preserving; everything else verbatim); stamp its fingerprint (orbit fingerprint --stamp) so --check stays all-verified.

findings.title: Iter-1 resolution #3 did not land: the normative uncertainty-default sentence is absent from the Invocation-provenance requirement
findings.recommendation: address-reviews-2026-07-09T15-58-31Z.json records finding #3 resolved with 'Invocation-provenance requirement now states normatively: uncertain provenance SHALL be treated as AI-mediated — one extra click, never a silent proceed', but no such sentence exists in the spec: grep 'uncertain' over specs/ returns nothing, and commit a5a0a56 (the iter-1 resolution commit) added no such line to this file. The default currently lives only in design.md (Risks) and tasks.md 2.1 — exactly the state the original WARNING flagged. The 'AI-mediated means everything else' catch-all is close but does not state the uncertainty default an implementer must apply at the margin. Land the promised sentence in the Invocation-provenance rule requirement (e.g. after the AI-mediated definition: 'When provenance is uncertain, it SHALL be treated as AI-mediated — one extra click, never a silent proceed.'). Do not edit the past address-reviews emit (audit trail is lifecycle-invariant); just make the artifact match it.

findings.title: Task 2.4's generic '(+ any body quoting stock assessments)' — onboard.ts is the one concrete other carrier; name it
findings.recommendation: grep over src/core/templates/workflows/ shows exactly two bodies quoting imperative Next: labels from the stock assessments: review.ts (15 hits, named in 2.4) and onboard.ts:78 (Phase 3 description quotes 'Next: /orbit:apply <name>.' and 'Next: /orbit:review --as proposal --fresh <name>.'). apply-change.ts:122 also renders a literal 'Next: <next_command...>' completion line (covered by 2.5's verbatim-readout subtraction). Task 2.6's no-imperative-Next grep test would catch a miss, but naming onboard.ts in 2.4 saves the implementer the rediscovery.
